  PROBLEM: The wave-judge Codex fallback uses `--sandbox read-only` and strips many env credentials, but the Claude pool token files at `${RUNNER_TEMP}/claude-pool/tokens/` (mode 0600, same user) remain readable by the Codex process.
  WHY: `--sandbox read-only` prevents writes but permits reads. `shell_environment_policy.filters.OPENROUTER_API_KEY="exclude"` only filters env vars from model-launched shell commands, not filesystem access. The pool directory is not cleared or masked before the Codex fallback runs, so the model can read the token files and exfiltrate them through the judge output that reaches GitHub.
